name: unusual_whales
text:
Anthropic would need about $602 billion in annual revenue to earn a 20% return on its roughly $1 trillion in compute commitments, per FT

The math: a 20% return on $1 trillion is $200 billion in after-tax profit. At a 17% tax rate, that’s about $241 billion before tax, and at a 40% operating margin, it takes about $602 billion in revenue.

That’s more than Alphabet’s $471 billion or Apple’s $478 billion in annual revenue. It’s about two-thirds of the $908 billion earned by all 76 software and IT services companies in the S&P 1500 combined.

name: unusual_whales
text:
BREAKING: Trump has "grown frustrated" with JD Vance for blaming Republicans' midterm losses on the Iran war, per The New York Times.

Trump first seemed unbothered by Vance's view that the war cost the GOP votes, saying, "I think it's largely true." But over the past two weeks, he has told aides and allies that Vance should have said Trump made the right call in going to war with Iran.

Meanwhile, Trump has privately praised Secretary of State Marco Rubio and suggested he could be a strong presidential candidate.

The report comes as the 2028 race starts to take shape. Vance has long been seen as Trump's likely successor.
